title: VERIFY T-480: --changed never misses a test that covers the change
acceptance_criteria: Pick 3 real modules under .harness/bin; for each, compare --changed's selection against a grep of the tests that mention the module; any test the grep finds and --changed misses is a defect. Run test_fast_tests.py only. Verdict.

notes.note: VERDICT done. Compared --changed against grep over 12 real bin modules (lock, portalock, harness_common, roster, dispatch_token, log_event, notify, condorcet, attest, blackboard, precedent, warrant). Grep by file name: zero misses (the only difference was a false positive, portalock.py matching lock.py as a substring). Word-stem greps add only prose and comment mentions plus transitive imports (harness_common, portalock reached through other modules), which the static scan documents as out of reach. Ran test_fast_tests.py only.
